name: Rubbersheet Visualization
definition: A technique to visualize 2-D sampling space data as 3-D height fields to show 'ups and downs' in data values, leveraging human familiarity with physical height.
summary: Rubbersheet Visualization elevates a 2D grid into 3D by displacing vertices along the Z-axis based on scalar values, creating a relief map that directly deforms the input geometry.
